gamerule.arcane_spells.terrain_damage.de: When off, spells still hurt and knock back creatures, but never break blocks or set off TNT.
spell.arcane_spells.arcane_bolt.descript: Hold to charge, release to fire a bolt that explodes on impact.
spell.arcane_spells.chain_lightning.desc: Strikes the creature you aim at, then leaps between others nearby, weakening with each jump.
spell.arcane_spells.blink.description: Teleport a short distance in the direction you look.
spell.arcane_spells.arcane_ward.descript: A shell of runes that absorbs hits and turns projectiles back on their shooter.
spell.arcane_spells.frost_nova.descripti: A burst of cold that damages, slows and freezes everything around you.
spell.arcane_spells.celestial_judgment.d: Channel until the circle closes, then release: a pillar of starlight bores into the marked ground and detonates.
spell.arcane_spells.meteor_swarm.descrip: Channel, then release: a burning sigil opens over the marked ground and rains meteors across it.
spell.arcane_spells.singularity.descript: Channel, then release: a black hole drags in everything nearby, devours the ground, then collapses.
spell.arcane_spells.chrono_field.descrip: Channel, then release: time stops in a dome around you. Blows struck inside it land at once, harder, when it ends.
spell.arcane_spells.astral_gate.descript: Channel, then release: step through a gate to the place you marked, far away, or look straight up to gate home. Both ends stay open for anyone.
message.arcane_spells.channel_unfinished: Hold until the circle closes to cast %s
message.arcane_spells.too_close: Too close: you would be caught in it
